source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.en: I will walk before the Lord * in the land of the living.

text.la: Heu mihi Dómine, * quia incolátus meus prolongátus est.
text.en: Woe is me! O Lord, * that my sojourn is long.

text.la: Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
text.en: The Lord shall keep thee from all evil, * the Lord shall keep thy soul.

text.la: Si iniquitátes * observáveris, Dómine: Dómine, quis sustinébit?
text.en: If Thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, * O Lord, who shall stand.

text.la: Opera * mánuum tuárum, Dómine, ne despícias.
text.en: O Lord, forsake not * the works of thine own hands.

text.la: Omne * quod dat mihi Pater, ad me véniet; et eum qui venit ad me, non eíciam foras.
text.en: All that the Father giveth Me shall come to Me; * and him that cometh to Me I will in no wise cast out.

text.la: Fidélium, Deus, ómnium Cónditor et Redémptor, animábus famulórum famularúmque tuárum remissiónem cunctórum tríbue peccatórum: ut indulgéntiam, quam semper optavérunt, piis supplicatiónibus consequántur:
text.en: O God, who art thyself at once the Maker and the Redeemer of all thy faithful ones, grant unto the souls of thy servants and handmaids remission of all their sins, making of our entreaties unto our great Father a mean whereby they may have that forgiveness which they have ever hoped for.
